title: SAFETYPAIRS: ISOLATING SAFETY CRITICAL IMAGE FEATURES WITH COUNTERFACTUAL IMAGE GENERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) ability to correctly classify counterfactual image pairs that contain hateful, derogatory, or demeaning sentiments against protected demographic groups (e.g., race, religion, sexual orientation, gender, disability) versus their safe image counterparts.

Generating targeted counterfactual image pairs that isolate specific safety-critical features (e.g., weapons, explicit content) to remove spurious background correlations present in conventional classification datasets, and evaluating the improved generalization of lightweight guard models trained on this data.
